materials.cover_letter:
You're building an AI agent that has to get customer experience right on the first try. I build AI agents and the evaluation systems to prove they work. That's the job, and I've been doing it for seven years.

At Redwood I built FlareGuard, an AI content validation workflow with automated benchmarks and regression detection. Escalations dropped 70 to 80 percent because bad output stopped reaching production. I redesigned a 200-article help portal with role-aware navigation and rebuilt a PDF pipeline that finally closed a years-long customer complaint. At Bird I migrated 500-plus Zendesk articles with conditional content, and at Attentive I owned documentation for the SMS and MMS platform, working directly with Support and Engineering.

Your role is about retrieval precision, hallucination rates, and guardrails that keep the agent from doing the wrong thing. That's not a side project for me, it's the core of my work. I'd welcome the conversation.
